title: 3x Fantasi | 70/30 Shortfill Bundle
description:
Fantasi 70/30 E-Liquid Bundle Pack:
If you’re a fan of our Fantasi vape juices in 70/30 mix, then you’re going to love this bundle! We’ve bundled together our mouthwatering flavors in Fantasi Shortfilld so you can save money, whilst stocking up on your favorite E-liquids for no extra cost.
Cherry
–
Fresh and fruity, with a full rich palate of flavors is cooled and sweetened into a much-loved all-day vape
Blueberry & Honeydew-
Blissful notes of sweet, slightly tart blueberries balanced out with the luscious flavors of melon for a truly unique flavor combo.
Lemon
–
Packed with zingy lemons with a touch of sweetness that dances on your tongue.
Vape juice is made with a 70/30 mix (70% VG to 30% PG). As VG is thicker than PG, you’ll need a high-powered Sub Ohm device to ensure the E-liquid is vaporised correctly. All of our Fantasi Vape Liquids come in a range of sizes and strengths. You can get your 0mg Fantasi 70/30 vape juice in 120ml Shortfill Bottle.
If you want nicotine with your Shortfills, we stock 100ml and 120ml bottles at either 3mg or 6mg nicotine strength. You can also grab a 10ml E Liquid bottle with nicotine already added. We stock 3mg, 6mg, 12mg and 18mg so you can just pop it into your tank and get vaping straight away!
Ingredients:
Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, Or Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Honeydew X Blueberry Shortfill
1x Cherry Shortfill
1x Lemon Shortfill
Specifications:
Ratio
70/30
Size
10ml, 50ml, 60ml, 100ml
Nicotine Strength
3mg, 6mg
Flavor
Apple, Citrus, Drinks, Fruit, Grape, Ice Cool, Lemonade, Mango, Orange, Tropical
Highlights
3x tantalising Fantasi E-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 70/30 mix for sub-ohm vaping!
Perfect for cloud-chasing vapers
3 popular Fantasi E-liquids bundled together to save you even more money
